name: InstaWallet
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the Blockchain Graveyard label and description.
rootCause: Given that a database was accessed, this was probably a breach of infrastructure. The Instawallet service is suspended indefinitely until we are able to develop an alternative architecture. Our database was fraudulently accessed, due to the very nature of Instawallet it is impossible to reopen the service as-is.
